10 Women Are Sharing The Unbelievable Things They Did After Finding Out Their Partner Was Cheating
1.”I stole the girl from him and kicked him to the curb.”
2.”I took his Apple Watch from the table and viewed his messages. Got the numbers of two of the women and texted them. One of the women responded and confirmed everything, but the other one was silent. I looked up the woman who didn’t respond on social media and found out she was married, so I sent pics of their messages to her husband.”
3.”I bought a ‘congrats on your new home’ greeting card and put it on top of the pile of all his belongings that I’d packed into rubbish bags and put in the middle of the driveway.”
4.”I put glitter in his brand new snowboard boots. He was pissed. I don’t care. Twinkle Toes broke my heart, he can sparkle until he gets new boots.”
5.”I rubbed his toothbrush on the toilet.”
6.”I hired a moving company to get all of his stuff out of my house and into a storage unit so I wouldn’t have to see him again. I asked the movers if they could get boxes since I had a small vehicle, and they said they would figure something out.”
“Well, they went to the business next door — an adult video store — and ended up packing all of his things in boxes with porn labels. The dumbass cheated on me with a 19-year-old and ended up unpacking his belongings from boxes that said ‘barely legal’ and ‘milf hunters.’ I didn’t realize how hilarious that was at the time, but I thoroughly enjoy it now.”
7.”I catfished him on Tinder. I set up a date 30 minutes away from him, asked him to buy ‘me’ flowers for the date, asked him to save our table at the restaurant, and then obviously his lil’ date never showed up.”
8.”I unpicked the crotch of all his trousers!”
9.”He didn’t know that I knew. I walked into our room with the girl he’d been cheating on me with on a video call. She confessed everything. The look on his face when I turned the phone around to show who I was talking to will forever be priceless.”
10.”He left himself logged into Facebook on my computer after I had repeatedly told him to stay off my computer, so I tagged her on Facebook from his account and outed the affair and called her the W-word.”
“This was before ‘post review.’ Back then, if someone tagged you in a post, it immediately went on your feed for everyone to see. I regret it. Eight months of dealing with his antics without doing anything unhinged, and I slipped once. From then on, he persistently used the Facebook post to suggest to people that I’m just as bad as he is, if not worse.”
